name: SD-RAN ran-simulator
description: RAN simulator from ONF's SD-RAN project. Simulates CU/DU nodes and RU cells via O-RAN E2AP standard with a YAML-based topology model.

docker_support.docker_evidence: Docker containers available on Docker Hub. Deployed as part of SDRAN-in-a-Box (RiaB). Note: source code is read-only; functional binaries only available as Docker containers.

eval_notes: O-RAN E2AP compliant simulator with gRPC API for runtime topology changes. Simulates dynamic RAN environment. Useful for O-RAN/RIC integration evals. Part of ONF SD-RAN ecosystem.
